name: Undo after rejecting at offer_accepted: links close on rejection, the restored stage gets a working link, the flow continues
description:
Objective: Undo after rejecting at offer_accepted: links close on rejection, the restored stage's link reopens, the flow continues.
Preconditions: Kesef CRM QA at the configured origin; authorized test account; an existing application in the needed state discovered read-only, or an unsaved intake whose writes are blocked.
Steps:
1. Drive the application to the stage and collect its email links (offer, requirements, DocuSign).
2. Reject; open every link.
3. Undo Rejection; open every link again.
4. Take the restored stage's next step (re-send offer, requirements, verify Stipulations, send and sign the contract).
Expected: Every email link allows no action after rejection; after undo the restored stage's own link (offer / Outstanding Requirements) works again, other old links stay dead, and the next step works.
